metadata.description: Region of the existing Log Analytics workspace.
Exact web, worker and email reconciler job names in the selected workspace.
Enable only after live query validation and review of the existing notification destination.

variables.sourceQuery:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where ContainerAppName_s in (workloads) or tostring(column_ifexists('ContainerJobName_s', '')) in (workloads)
| extend entry = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend component = tostring(entry.component), event = tostring(entry.event), outcome = tostring(entry.outcome)
variables.mailPredicate:
| where
    (component == 'email-worker' and event == 'provider_submission_failed' and outcome == 'failed')
    or (component == 'email-worker' and event == 'delivery_lifecycle_update' and outcome in ('failed', 'failed_after_provider_acceptance'))
    or (component == 'email-verification-delivery' and event == 'provider_submission' and outcome in ('unknown', 'rejected'))
    or (component == 'email-verification-delivery' and event == 'submission_failed' and outcome == 'blocked')
    or (component == 'password-reset-delivery' and event == 'provider_submission_failed' and outcome in ('acceptance_unknown', 'failed_permanent'))
    or (component == 'password-reset-delivery' and event == 'provider_submission_skipped' and outcome == 'blocked')
    or (component == 'password-reset-delivery' and event == 'recovery_decrypt' and outcome in ('blocked_configuration', 'failed_terminal'))
    or (component == 'password-reset-delivery' and event == 'provider_acceptance_durability' and outcome in ('critical_conflict_audit_and_reconciliation_failed', 'critical_both_writes_failed', 'database_write_failed_reconciliation_queued', 'reconciliation_queue_failed_database_recorded'))
    or (component == 'password-reset-delivery' and event == 'provider_acceptance_conflict' and outcome == 'terminal_correlation_conflict')
    or (component == 'password-reset-delivery' and event == 'provider_acceptance_reconciliation_failed' and outcome in ('terminal_correlation_conflict', 'terminal_persistence_error', 'terminal_state_conflict', 'audit_retry_required'))
    or (component == 'invitation-email' and event == 'provider_submission' and outcome == 'failed_or_unknown')
| project TimeGenerated, component, event, outcome
variables.reconcilerPredicate:
| where (component == 'email-verification-reconciler' and event == 'run' and outcome == 'failed')
    or (component == 'password-reset-reconciler' and event == 'reconciliation_failed' and outcome == 'failed')
| project TimeGenerated, component, event, outcome

properties.description: Email submission failed, acceptance is uncertain, or delivery state could not be persisted. Inspect the lifecycle before resending; this does not measure inbox delivery.
Email verification or password-reset reconciler logged an execution failure. Does not detect missing executions or missing log ingestion.
